_comment: BMW F10 (2012) coding catalog. Screenshot BimmerCode categories are mapped to F10 modules (FRM not FEM, JBBF not REM). ecuMap blocks are ILLUSTRATIVE and verified:false — the app writes them in demo mode and refuses them on a real car until you import maps from your own CAFD/NCD. See README.

modules.name: FRM
modules.description: Auto Start Stop function, doors/windows, lighting, mirrors (F10 FRM3 — this car has no FEM)

modules.name: HU
modules.description: Audio, display options iDrive system, video (CIC on a 2012 F10)

modules.name: KOMBI
modules.description: Display options instrument cluster, driving mode, fuel reserve warnings

modules.name: JBBF
modules.description: PDC (Park Distance Control), rear lighting, rear view camera, headlight washers, rain sensor (F10 JBBF — this car has no REM)

modules.name: DME
modules.description: Auto Start-Stop and engine live data

codings.name: Active Sound Design
codings.description: Turns the interior engine-sound speaker on or off.
codings.longDescription: Active Sound Design plays a synthesized engine note through a dedicated speaker so the cabin sounds sportier. Disable it for a quieter interior. Hardware must be fitted; coding a car without ASD does nothing audible.

codings.name: ASD Volume
codings.description: Cabin volume of the Active Sound Design speaker.
codings.longDescription: 0 is silent, 100 is the loudest profile the module will play. Start around 40 if you are trying the feature for the first time.

codings.name: Seat Belt Reminder
codings.description: Chimes when a front occupant is unbelted.
codings.longDescription: The crash-safety module owns the seat-belt reminder. Leave this on for safety; turning it off only silences the chime — the belt warning lamp in the cluster can still light.

codings.name: Passenger Belt Reminder
codings.description: Also chimes for an unbelted front passenger.
codings.longDescription: When enabled, the passenger occupancy sensor triggers the same reminder as the driver belt.

codings.name: Reminder Chime Volume
codings.description: How loud the seat-belt reminder chime is.
codings.longDescription: Does not disable the reminder, only how insistent it sounds.

codings.name: Initial Seat-Belt Chime
codings.description: Plays the initial three-chime seatbelt warning sequence at journey start.
codings.longDescription: The three-chime sequence is the first gentle reminder before the continuous chime escalates. Disabling it skips the introductory tone; the main belt-reminder logic (acsm_seatbelt_reminder) is unaffected. Safer default is to keep this on.

codings.name: Recirculation Memory
codings.description: Remembers the last recirculation setting after you switch the car off.
codings.longDescription: Factory default often returns to fresh air at every start. Enable this so the last recirc choice is restored.

codings.name: Comfort Ventilation
codings.description: Runs the blower briefly after lock on a hot day to vent the cabin.
codings.longDescription: Uses residual battery. Disable if you park for long periods without a trickle charger.

codings.name: Climate Auto-Start
codings.description: Climate control starts automatically with the ignition.
codings.longDescription: When off you must press AUTO or A/C each drive. When on, last climate settings resume with the ignition.

codings.name: Side View Camera
codings.description: Shows the side-view camera picture when you indicate at low speed.
codings.longDescription: Part of Surround View / Allround View. The cameras and TRSVC module must be fitted. On a 2012 F10 this is typically a dealer or retrofit option.

codings.name: Rear Camera Guidelines
codings.description: Draws steering-linked parking guidelines on the rear camera image.
codings.longDescription: Guidelines move with the steering angle. Disable if you prefer a clean camera picture.

codings.name: Camera While Moving
codings.description: Keeps the camera image on screen above walking pace.
codings.longDescription: Factory default hides the camera above ~20 km/h. Enabling this is for low-speed manoeuvring only — do not watch the screen while driving.
codings.warning: Keep your eyes on the road. Camera-in-motion is for parking-speed use only.

codings.name: Sport Shift Display
codings.description: Shows a sportier gear and shift-point display in the cluster.
codings.longDescription: Does not change shift maps by itself. Pair with driving-mode coding in ICM if you want Sport as the default.

codings.name: Default Shift Character
codings.description: Shift character used when you start the car.
codings.longDescription: Comfort is the factory default. Sport holds gears longer. This is a comfort coding, not a flash of transmission software.

codings.name: Cornering Lights
codings.description: Uses the front fog lights as cornering lights when turning at low speed.
codings.longDescription: When enabled, the front fog light on the side you are turning toward will activate as a supplemental cornering light whenever you make a slow turn (under 40 km/h). The fog lights must be physically installed for this feature to work.

codings.name: DRL Brightness
codings.description: Sets the daytime running light brightness as a percentage of maximum output.
codings.longDescription: Controls how bright the daytime running lights (DRLs) appear during daylight driving. The factory default is 70%. Values below 30% may not meet legal DRL requirements in some countries.

codings.name: Welcome Lights Duration
codings.description: How many seconds the exterior lights illuminate when you remotely unlock the car.
codings.longDescription: When you press unlock on the key fob, the exterior lights turn on to guide you to the car. Set to 0 to disable.

codings.name: Ambient Lighting Color
codings.description: Sets the color of the interior ambient lighting strips in the door panels and footwells.
codings.longDescription: The F10 has ambient LED strips in the door panels and footwells. RGB retrofits can use any profile; single-colour strips ignore the colour choice.

codings.name: Farewell Animation
codings.description: Plays a light fade-out sequence after you lock the car and walk away.
codings.longDescription: After locking, the exterior lights play a brief fade-out rather than switching off instantly.

codings.name: Driver-Only First Unlock
codings.description: First key fob press unlocks only the driver door; a second press unlocks all doors.
codings.longDescription: By default one press opens all four doors. With this coding the first press unlocks only the driver door.

codings.name: Daytime Running Lights
codings.description: Turns daytime running lights on or off.
codings.longDescription: Legal in many countries. Switching DRLs off may be illegal on public roads.

codings.name: Comfort Turn-Signal Blinks
codings.description: Number of flashes from a tap of the stalk (comfort indicator).
codings.longDescription: Factory is typically 3. 5 is a common choice so a lane change is more visible.

codings.name: Fold Mirrors on Lock
codings.description: Power-folds the door mirrors when you lock the car.
codings.longDescription: The mirror motors must be present (common on F10 with folding-mirror option). Unfolds on unlock.

codings.name: Tilt Passenger Mirror in Reverse
codings.description: Dips the passenger mirror toward the kerb when you select reverse.
codings.longDescription: Helps you see the kerb when parking. Memory seats/mirrors make the tilt smoother.

codings.name: Angel-Eye / DRL Mode
codings.description: Keeps the angel-eye rings on as daytime running lights.
codings.longDescription: Depends on headlamp hardware (halogen vs xenon). Does not convert halogen rings into LED.

codings.name: DRL Source Mode
codings.description: Selects which lamps act as daytime running lights.
codings.longDescription: Controls whether DRLs use only the angel-eye rings or also illuminate the tail lights at reduced brightness for better rear visibility. Actual behaviour depends on headlamp hardware fitted to the car.

codings.name: Angel-Eye Brightness
codings.description: Sets the brightness of the angel-eye rings as a percentage of maximum output.
codings.longDescription: Applies to the rings when used as position lights or DRLs. Does not affect xenon bulb output, only the ring elements.

codings.name: Welcome Lamps Selection
codings.description: Selects which exterior lamps join the welcome-light sequence on remote unlock.
codings.longDescription: Distinct from welcome-light duration (frm_welcome_lights). Choose whether only the parking/angel-eye lamps, also the low beams, or also the front fog lights illuminate during the welcome sequence.

codings.name: Emergency Brake Flasher
codings.description: Rapidly flashes the brake lights during hard braking to warn following traffic.
codings.longDescription: Activates when deceleration exceeds the ESS (Emergency Stop Signal) threshold. Works independently of ABS. Complies with ECE R48 in most European markets.

codings.name: Ambient Lighting Brightness
codings.description: Sets the brightness of the interior ambient LED strips as a percentage.
codings.longDescription: The F10 ambient LEDs default to ice-blue (see frm_ambient_color) at a factory brightness that can feel dim. Raise this value for a more prominent glow. RGB retrofit strips may clip near 100%.

codings.name: Video in Motion
codings.description: Removes the lock that prevents video playback on the iDrive screen while driving.
codings.longDescription: Factory default blocks video whenever the car is in motion. Intended for rear-seat passengers only. Illegal for the driver in most places.
codings.warning: This disables BMW's safety restriction on in-motion video. Intended for rear passengers only. The driver watching video while driving is illegal in most jurisdictions.

codings.name: Speed Limit Display
codings.description: Shows the current road's posted speed limit in the instrument cluster and/or HUD.
codings.longDescription: Reads speed-limit data from the navigation map. Accuracy depends on map data being current.

codings.name: Ambient Lighting iDrive Menu
codings.description: Reveals the ambient lighting control submenu in the iDrive Settings.
codings.longDescription: Adds an Ambient Lighting page so you can change brightness/colour from iDrive instead of recoding.

codings.name: Sport Display
codings.description: Adds a performance monitoring page to iDrive showing g-force, throttle, brake, and gear data.
codings.longDescription: Unlocks the Sport Display page. Data comes from DSC and DME — no extra hardware.

codings.name: Screen Auto-Off Timer
codings.description: Minutes of inactivity before the iDrive screen automatically dims to black.
codings.longDescription: Set to 0 to never auto-off.

codings.name: Video Menu
codings.description: Shows the Video source page in iDrive (DVD / AUX video).
codings.longDescription: Useful after a media retrofit. Does nothing if no video source is installed.

codings.name: Legal Disclaimer Skip
codings.description: Suppresses or shortens the legal disclaimer shown on navigation, camera, and PDC screens at startup.
codings.longDescription: The CIC displays a legal screen before navigation and camera views. Enabling this skips or shortens those prompts. The disclaimer content itself is unchanged; you acknowledge the terms when you configure the car.

codings.name: Screen Off on Door Open
codings.description: Turns the iDrive screen off automatically when the driver door is opened.
codings.longDescription: Useful for privacy and to reduce cabin light when parked. The screen returns when the door is closed or the system is touched.

codings.name: TPMS Tire Pressure Display
codings.description: Shows individual tire pressures (and temperature if available) in the iDrive menu.
codings.longDescription: Requires RDC (Reifendruckkontrolle) wheel-speed and pressure sensors to be fitted. Many F10s have RDC as standard or an option; without the hardware this menu item has no data to display.

codings.name: Startup Gauge Sweep
codings.description: Sweeps all instrument cluster needles to maximum and back when you start the engine.
codings.longDescription: Needle staging is cosmetic and lasts about two seconds.

codings.name: Digital Speedometer
codings.description: Shows your exact current speed as a large number in the cluster info display.
codings.longDescription: Supplements the analog needle — it does not replace it.

codings.name: Oil Temperature Gauge
codings.description: Activates the blank gauge slot as a live oil temperature readout.
codings.longDescription: Uses oil temperature from DME. Wait for ~80 °C before hard driving.

codings.name: Speedometer Unit
codings.description: Switches all speed displays in the cluster between km/h and mph.
codings.longDescription: Also affects cruise-control speed display and, if equipped, the HUD.

codings.name: Lap Timer
codings.description: Unlocks a lap timer function in the cluster accessible via the steering wheel buttons.
codings.longDescription: Normally restricted to M Performance models. Cosmetic only.

codings.name: Startup Chime
codings.description: Plays the BMW welcome chime through the audio system when the ignition is turned on.
codings.longDescription: Disable if the gong is intrusive in quiet places.

codings.name: Fuel Reserve Warning
codings.description: Shows a more prominent low-fuel warning in the cluster.
codings.longDescription: Does not change the actual reserve quantity, only how insistently it is announced.

codings.name: Driving Mode Display
codings.description: How the current driving mode is shown in the cluster.
codings.longDescription: Useful if you code ICM default mode and want the cluster to match.

codings.name: Active Cruise Control Default
codings.description: Makes Active Cruise Control the default when you press the cruise stalk.
codings.longDescription: Without ACC hardware this does nothing. With ACC fitted, the stalk starts ACC instead of plain cruise.

codings.name: Default Driving Mode
codings.description: Driving mode restored at every start (Comfort / Sport / Sport+).
codings.longDescription: Does not add hardware. Sport+ may be greyed out on cars without the sport chassis.

codings.name: Remember DTC Button
codings.description: Keeps Dynamic Traction Control engaged across ignition cycles.
codings.longDescription: Factory DTC (traction off) resets at every start. Enable this to remember the last state.

codings.name: ACC Default Following Distance
codings.description: Sets the default following distance step for Active Cruise Control at ignition-on.
codings.longDescription: Step 1 is the shortest gap, step 4 the longest. The driver can still adjust while driving using the stalk. ACC radar hardware (SA 5DP) must be fitted; coding this without ACC hardware has no effect.

codings.name: PDC Auto-On in Reverse
codings.description: Park Distance Control starts automatically when you select reverse.
codings.longDescription: F10 has no REM; PDC and rear power distribution live in the junction box (JBBF).

codings.name: Rear Fog Light Legalisation
codings.description: Enables the rear fog output if the lamp is fitted.
codings.longDescription: Only code this if the rear fog lamp is physically installed and legal in your country.

codings.name: Rear View Camera Enable
codings.description: Tells the junction box a rear camera is installed so reverse shows the picture.
codings.longDescription: The camera and head-unit input must exist. Pair with TRSVC guidelines if you have Surround View.

codings.name: Comfort Window Close
codings.description: Hold lock on the fob to close windows from the junction-box window module.
codings.longDescription: Same idea as CAS remote windows; JBBF actually drives the motors on F10.

codings.name: Headlight Washer Pump
codings.description: Enables the headlight washer pump when the windscreen washers are used at speed.
codings.longDescription: Activates the headlight washer nozzles and pump. The nozzle bezels and pump must be physically installed (many F10s had this as an option). Coding this on a car without the hardware will attempt to energise a pump that does not exist.

codings.name: Rain Sensor Sensitivity
codings.description: Adjusts how aggressively the automatic wipers respond to rain.
codings.longDescription: Higher sensitivity triggers the wipers earlier and more frequently in light rain. Lower sensitivity is better for drizzle-heavy climates where the default feels too reactive. Requires the rain/light sensor in the interior mirror (RLS on JBBF), not the KAFAS camera.

codings.name: Seat Heat Setting Retention
codings.description: How long the seat-heat stage is remembered between ignition cycles.
codings.longDescription: Controls whether the junction box retains the last seat-heat stage and for how long. Distinct from the SM default stage (sm_heat_memory), which sets a fixed start value. 'Until changed' means the stage persists indefinitely.

codings.name: Acoustical Confirmation
codings.description: Chirp / beep from the alarm siren when locking and unlocking.
codings.longDescription: Roof Function Centre owns the siren. Pair with CAS horn-on-lock if you want both.

codings.name: Alarm System
codings.description: Enables the interior/tilt alarm if the siren and sensors are fitted.
codings.longDescription: Coding this on a car without DWA hardware will not add an alarm.

codings.name: Interior Light Delay
codings.description: Seconds the dome light stays on after you close the doors.
codings.longDescription: Set to 0 for instant off.

codings.name: Panic Alarm on Fob
codings.description: Hold the lock button to trigger the panic siren.
codings.longDescription: Useful as an emergency attention signal. Disable if accidental presses are a problem.

codings.name: Seat Heating
codings.description: Enables driver seat heating stages if the elements are fitted.
codings.longDescription: Does not add heaters. If the switch does nothing, the hardware is missing.

codings.name: Default Heat Stage
codings.description: Seat-heat stage restored at start (0 = off).
codings.longDescription: 0–3 matching the switch positions.

codings.name: Easy Entry
codings.description: Seat slides back when you switch off to make getting out easier.
codings.longDescription: Memory seats required. The seat moves to the saved position on the next start.

codings.name: Power Tailgate
codings.description: Enables the electric tailgate if the lift motor is fitted.
codings.longDescription: 2012 F10 5 Series often has a manual boot. Coding this without a motor does nothing.

codings.name: Opening Height
codings.description: How far the power tailgate rises, as a percentage of full height.
codings.longDescription: Useful in low garages. 100 is fully open.

codings.name: Open from Key Fob
codings.description: Hold the boot button on the key to open the power tailgate.
codings.longDescription: Requires power tailgate hardware.

codings.name: Close from Interior Button
codings.description: Enables closing the power tailgate using the interior boot-release button.
codings.longDescription: The interior button in the boot area can be used to pull the tailgate closed from inside. Requires the power tailgate motor to be installed.

codings.name: Close from Fob (Short Press)
codings.description: Closes the power tailgate with a short press of the key fob boot button instead of a long press.
codings.longDescription: Factory default requires a long press on the boot button to close the tailgate. Enable this for a single normal press. The existing hkl_fob_open behaviour (open) is a separate coding and is unaffected.

codings.name: PDC Volume
codings.description: Loudness of the parking-sensor beeps.
codings.longDescription: Independent of the iDrive volume knob on many F10s.

codings.name: Visual PDC
codings.description: Shows the parking-sensor graphic on iDrive in addition to the beeps.
codings.longDescription: Needs a compatible head unit. Rear-view camera overlay is separate (TRSVC).

codings.name: Front Sensors
codings.description: Enables front parking sensors if they are fitted.
codings.longDescription: Rear-only cars should leave this off.

codings.name: Auto Door Lock Speed
codings.description: All doors automatically lock when the car reaches this speed. Set to 0 to disable.
codings.longDescription: BMW factory default is typically 15 km/h.

codings.name: Remote Window Operation
codings.description: Hold the lock or unlock button on the key fob to close or open all windows.
codings.longDescription: Hold lock ~3 seconds to close, unlock to vent. Car must be stationary.

codings.name: Comfort Access Touch Unlock
codings.description: Unlock the car by touching the door handle while the key is in your pocket.
codings.longDescription: Comfort Access antennas must be installed. 2012 F10 often has this as an option.

codings.name: Horn Confirmation on Lock
codings.description: Beeps the horn once to confirm the car locked successfully.
codings.longDescription: Disable in quiet neighbourhoods. FZD acoustical confirmation is the siren alternative.

codings.name: Auto Re-Lock Timer
codings.description: If you unlock the car but do not open a door, it re-locks itself after this many seconds.
codings.longDescription: Set to 0 to disable.

codings.name: Remember Auto Start-Stop Off
codings.description: Keeps Auto Start-Stop disabled across ignition cycles when you press the MSA button.
codings.longDescription: On pre-LCI F10s (including 2012) this memory function is typically coded in CAS rather than DME. If cas_msa_memory does not work on your car, try dme_msa_memory instead — both items exist in the catalog because different ECU builds handle this on different modules. Do not delete the DME item.

codings.name: Start with Auto Start-Stop Off
codings.description: Auto Start-Stop is off at every ignition-on without pressing the MSA button.
codings.longDescription: Stronger than memory: the system always starts deactivated. The MSA button can still re-enable it for the current trip. On pre-LCI 2012 F10 this function typically lives in CAS.

codings.name: Comfort Access Close
codings.description: Locks and closes the car by touching the door handle from outside while the key is in your pocket.
codings.longDescription: Distinct from cas_remote_window (fob window operation). Requires Comfort Access antennas (SA 322) and must be enabled in CAS. Touch the handle exterior sensor area while all doors are shut to lock and trigger comfort close.

codings.name: Unlock on Key Removal
codings.description: Automatically unlocks the doors when the ignition key is removed or the engine is switched off.
codings.longDescription: Unlocks all doors when CAS detects the key has been extracted (or the engine has been switched off for keyless-start cars). Useful if you prefer the car unlocked the moment you stop.

codings.name: HUD Speed Unit
codings.description: Sets whether the Head-Up Display shows speed in km/h or mph.
codings.longDescription: Independent from the cluster unit setting.

codings.name: Navigation Arrows in HUD
codings.description: Displays turn-by-turn navigation arrows and street names in the Head-Up Display.
codings.longDescription: Requires an active navigation destination.

codings.name: HUD Default Brightness
codings.description: The starting brightness level of the HUD projection each time you enter the car.
codings.longDescription: Level 5 is a good all-day compromise.

codings.name: HUD Speed Warning
codings.description: Flashes a warning in the HUD if you exceed this speed. Set to 0 to disable.
codings.longDescription: A value of 130 is useful near the German advisory limit.

codings.name: Turn Signal Arrows in HUD
codings.description: Displays turn-signal indicator arrows in the Head-Up Display when indicating.
codings.longDescription: Shows left or right arrow overlays in the HUD projection while the turn signal is active. Requires SA 610 HUD hardware. A complementary coding in KOMBI may be needed on some builds to fully enable HUD turn-signal content — the HUD item here is the primary toggle.

codings.name: Auto Start-Stop
codings.description: Allows the engine to stop at idle to save fuel.
codings.longDescription: On a 2012 F10 this is a DME coding, not FEM. Disable it here to keep the engine running at lights. The cluster MSA button still works as a temporary override when this is on.

codings.name: Remember Start-Stop Off
codings.description: Keeps Auto Start-Stop off across ignition cycles when you press the MSA button.
codings.longDescription: Factory MSA always comes back on at the next start. Enable this so off stays off.
